newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes off as Cenbnk stays away.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes off as Cenbnk stays away.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed off at 493.25/494.25 per dollar after the Central Bank largely abstained from selling dollars into a busy market, despite strong corporate demand, traders said.
The unit closed Tuesday at 492.00/493.00 per dollar.
"The Central Bank didn't sell anything today and everyone's been left short," said one trader.

Brokers said the exchange rate could carry-on weakening if high levels of domestic liquidity and low interest rates continued. With overnight interbank lending rates yielding a low four percent, "there is no other option at the moment than buy dollars," said one trader.
"The bolivar's recent erratic movements are making corporates nervous and that's spurring dollar demand," he added.
